title: Promises guaranteed returns or stock tips
why: No genuine investment guarantees returns. Fake trading groups show fake profits on a fake app until you put in a large amount.
examples: Join our VIP stock tips group on WhatsApp. Guaranteed returns every week!
Invest Rs 10,000 and get 30% returns monthly, assured profit.
safe: Your SIP of Rs 500 has been processed for HDFC Index Fund.
Fixed deposit matured. Interest credited to your account.
